info.title: Hermiq Register
info.description: Schedule autonomous AI agents in Nextcloud

x-openregister.description: Schedule autonomous AI agents in Nextcloud

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description: A schedule that fires an OpenRegister agent on a cron expression, a fixed interval, or once at a future time.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the OpenRegister Agent this schedule runs (reference to the Agent entity owned by OpenRegister)

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Trigger type: run once, on a fixed interval, or on a cron expression

intervalMinutes.title: Interval (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: Interval in minutes between runs (required when kind=interval)

runAt.title: Run at
runAt.description: Timestamp of the single run (required when kind=once)

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Optional task text passed to the agent run

deliver.title: Deliver to
deliver.description: Where the run output is delivered

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Disabled schedules are skipped by the dispatcher

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Optional finite-repeat control; omit or null to run forever

times.title: Total runs
times.description: Total number of runs before the schedule is removed

nextRun.title: Next run
nextRun.description: Derived: next fire time — written by the dispatcher, not the user

lastStatus.title: Last status
lastStatus.description: Derived: outcome of the last run — written by the dispatcher

lastError.title: Last error
lastError.description: Derived: error message from the last run, if any — written by the dispatcher

deliverTarget.title: Deliver target
deliverTarget.description: When deliver=talk, the Nextcloud Talk room token to post to (the owner must be a member). If empty, delivery falls back to the owner's Note-to-self conversation.

lastDeliveryError.title: Last delivery error
lastDeliveryError.description: Derived: the delivery error from the last run, if any — written by the delivery layer; cleared on a successful delivery

requiresApproval.title: Requires approval
requiresApproval.description: When true, a due run does not execute automatically — the dispatcher creates a pending Approval and notifies the reviewer; the run proceeds only after approval (EU AI Act Art. 14 human oversight).

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Who must approve a gated run — a Nextcloud user id or group id (see reviewerType). If empty, the schedule owner is the reviewer.

reviewerType.title: Reviewer type
reviewerType.description: Whether reviewer is a Nextcloud user id or a group id.

retryEnabled.title: Retry enabled
retryEnabled.description: When true, a failed run is retried with exponential backoff (up to retryMaxAttempts) before being marked dead-letter (run-reliability).

retryMaxAttempts.title: Retry max attempts
retryMaxAttempts.description: Total attempts (including the first) for one occurrence before it is marked dead-letter.

retryBackoffBaseSeconds.title: Retry backoff base (seconds)
retryBackoffBaseSeconds.description: Base delay for exponential backoff between retry attempts: backoffBase * 2^(attempt-1).

circuitBreakerThreshold.title: Circuit breaker threshold
circuitBreakerThreshold.description: Consecutive dead-lettered occurrences before the schedule is auto-paused.

retryState.title: Retry state
retryState.description: Derived: in-progress retry-sequence bookkeeping — written by the dispatcher, not the user; null when no retry is pending.

attempt.title: Attempt
attempt.description: The last attempt number that failed.

nextAttemptAt.title: Next attempt at
nextAttemptAt.description: When the next retry attempt is due to fire.

consecutiveDeadLetters.title: Consecutive dead-letters
consecutiveDeadLetters.description: Derived: consecutive dead-lettered occurrences — written by the dispatcher; resets to 0 on any successful run.

Approval.title: Approval
Approval.description: A human-oversight approval request for a gated agent run or tool invocation (EU AI Act Art. 14); its status is the audited pending→approved/denied decision. Gates a scheduled run (sourceType=schedule, the original shape), a flow-triggered run (sourceType=flow, from OpenRegister's AgentRunRequestedEvent), a webhook-triggered run (sourceType=webhook, from an external system calling the agent's inbound webhook), or an un-granted destructive tool invocation attempted mid-run (sourceType=tool, agent-tool-governance-and-disclosure).

sourceType.title: Source type
sourceType.description: What the gated action resumes into on approval: a Hermiq Schedule (default, back-compatible), a flow-triggered agent run, a webhook-triggered agent run, or an un-granted destructive tool invocation (nothing auto-resumes — the next invocation attempt of the same agentId+toolId proceeds).

scheduleId.title: Schedule
scheduleId.description: UUID of the Schedule whose run is gated. Present only when sourceType=schedule.

correlationId.title: Correlation ID
correlationId.description: Idempotency key for a flow-triggered or webhook-triggered approval — the dispatch's correlationId. Present only when sourceType=flow or sourceType=webhook; scheduleId serves this role for sourceType=schedule.

flowContext.title: Flow context
flowContext.description: The flow-triggered run's resume context (subjectUuid/subjectRegister/subjectSchema/resultField/skill/mode/flowName/correlationId). Present only when sourceType=flow.

webhookContext.title: Webhook context
webhookContext.description: The webhook-triggered run's resume context (agentId/payload/correlationId/requiresApproval/reviewer/reviewerType). The payload is redacted before it is stored here (redaction-before-persist). Present only when sourceType=webhook.

toolId.title: Tool ID
toolId.description: Full namespaced MCP tool id ({app}.{schema}.{verb} or {app}.{toolName}) whose invocation is gated. Present only when sourceType=tool; the idempotency key together with agentId.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent the gated run/invocation would act as.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt the gated run would send to the agent.

requestedAt.title: Requested at
requestedAt.description: When the approval was requested (the dispatcher gated the run).

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Resolved reviewer copied from the Schedule — a user id or group id (see reviewerType).

reviewerType.title: Reviewer type
reviewerType.description: Whether reviewer is a user id or a group id.

decidedAt.title: Decided at
decidedAt.description: Derived: when the decision was made — written by the decision endpoint.

decidedBy.title: Decided by
decidedBy.description: Derived: the user id who approved or denied — written by the decision endpoint.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional decision reason (typically supplied on denial).

AgentWebhook.title: Agent webhook
AgentWebhook.description: A per-agent, secret-authenticated inbound webhook (agent-webhook-trigger) that lets an external system (n8n, a CI pipeline, a third-party SaaS event) trigger a governed agent run without a Nextcloud session. Stores only a SHA-256 hash of the shared secret — never the plaintext at rest — plus the optional human-approval gate fields (mirroring Schedule's requiresApproval/reviewer/reviewerType). One AgentWebhook per agent.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent this webhook triggers. One AgentWebhook per agent.

secretHash.title: Secret hash
secretHash.description: Derived: hash('sha256', secret) — the plaintext secret is never persisted. Verified via hash_equals() at trigger time.

secretPrefix.title: Secret prefix
secretPrefix.description: Derived: the first 8 characters of the plaintext secret (e.g. "hwh_ab12"), for admin identification only — not sensitive on its own.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: false after revoke; the trigger endpoint rejects every request for a disabled webhook.

requiresApproval.title: Requires approval
requiresApproval.description: When true, a valid trigger does not run the agent automatically — a pending Approval (sourceType=webhook) is created and the reviewer notified; the run proceeds only after approval (EU AI Act Art. 14 human oversight).

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Who must approve a gated run — a Nextcloud user id or group id (see reviewerType). If empty, the agent owner is the reviewer.

reviewerType.title: Reviewer type
reviewerType.description: Whether reviewer is a Nextcloud user id or a group id.

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: When the webhook secret was first created.

rotatedAt.title: Rotated at
rotatedAt.description: Derived: when the secret was last rotated — null until the first rotation.

lastUsedAt.title: Last used at
lastUsedAt.description: Derived: when the trigger endpoint last accepted a valid, enabled request for this webhook — best-effort, non-fatal.

AiFeature.title: AI feature
AiFeature.description: A design-time inventory entry for a high-risk AI feature this platform provides (EU AI Act registration/oversight). Risk-classified and gated by a declarative lifecycle whose enable transition requires a DPO acknowledgement.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: The machine identifier of the AI feature (also the IAppConfig dpo_ack key suffix).

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of the AI feature.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the AI feature does and why it is risk-relevant.

riskCategory.title: Risk category
riskCategory.description: EU AI Act risk classification of the feature.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Activation state, managed by the OpenRegister lifecycle engine (never set directly).

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: The hermiq multi-tenancy scope used to key the DPO acknowledgement.

dpoAckBy.title: DPO acknowledged by
dpoAckBy.description: Derived: the user id of the DPO who acknowledged the feature — written by the acknowledge endpoint.

dpoAckAt.title: DPO acknowledged at
dpoAckAt.description: Derived: when the DPO acknowledgement was recorded — written by the acknowledge endpoint.

doel.title: Doel
doel.description: Algoritmekader: the purpose of the algorithm — why the public body deploys it. Mandatory only to publish to the Algoritmeregister.

wettelijkeGrondslag.title: Wettelijke grondslag
wettelijkeGrondslag.description: Algoritmekader: the legal basis for using the algorithm. Mandatory only to publish.

impacttoetsen.title: Impacttoetsen
impacttoetsen.description: Algoritmekader: the impact assessments performed (IAMA / DPIA / FRAIA) with a reference to each. Mandatory only to publish.

referentie.title: Referentie
referentie.description: A reference (document id / URL) to the completed assessment.

dataBronnen.title: Databronnen
dataBronnen.description: Algoritmekader: the data sources and data categories the algorithm uses. Mandatory only to publish.

menselijkeTussenkomst.title: Menselijke tussenkomst
menselijkeTussenkomst.description: Algoritmekader: the human-oversight arrangement (links to the human-approval gate). Mandatory only to publish.

verantwoordelijke.title: Verantwoordelijke
verantwoordelijke.description: Algoritmekader: the responsible organisation and its contact. Mandatory only to publish.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: A contact point (email / department) for the algorithm.

publicatiecategorie.title: Publicatiecategorie
publicatiecategorie.description: Algoritmekader: the publication category of the algorithm in the national register. Mandatory only to publish.

algoritmeregisterStatus.title: Algoritmeregister status
algoritmeregisterStatus.description: Publication state in the national Algoritmeregister. Managed by the publish / withdraw actions (never set directly).

algoritmeregisterRef.title: Algoritmeregister reference
algoritmeregisterRef.description: Derived: the external register id / URL of the published entry, empty until published.

TenantControl.title: Tenant control
TenantControl.description: Per-organisation kill-switch plus the stated EU AI Act Art. 12 retention-period policy (agent-lifecycle-governance). When engaged, the dispatcher halts all agent runs for the organisation (tenant scope comes from ObjectEntity.organisation).

engaged.title: Engaged
engaged.description: When true, all agent runs for this organisation are halted.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional reason for engaging the kill-switch.

engagedBy.title: Engaged by
engagedBy.description: The user id who engaged/disengaged the kill-switch.

retentionMonths.title: Retention period (months)
retentionMonths.description: Stated EU AI Act Art. 12 record-keeping retention period for this organisation's governance records; a value below 6 is rejected at the service layer. This is a stated policy only — it does not trigger automated purge/archive (agent-lifecycle-governance).

ModelPolicy.title: Model policy
ModelPolicy.description: Per-organisation allowlist of chat provider/model pairs an organisation's agents may use, plus an optional default model. A policy with no organisation (tenant scope empty) is the instance-wide default applied when an organisation has none of its own (tenant-model-policy). Enforced at ProviderFactory::createChatDriver() — every agent-turn trigger path (schedule, Run now, conversation, flow listener) is checked against the caller's effective policy.

allowed.title: Allowed providers
allowed.description: Allowlisted {provider, models[]} pairs drawn from the four supported chat drivers. An empty models[] for an allowed provider means any model id for that provider is permitted.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: One of the four supported chat drivers.

models.title: Models
models.description: Allowed model ids for this provider; empty means any model id is permitted.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Optional suggested default {provider, model} surfaced to the agent create/edit form; MUST itself be one of the allowed provider/model combinations (service-level validation).

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Per-organisation or per-agent spend guardrail (tokens and/or EUR per period): a soft threshold that warns without blocking, and a hard cap that blocks NEW runs for the budgeted scope at the same dispatch gate the kill-switch and human-approval gate use (never aborts a run already in progress). Current-period usage is computed on read from the existing run AuditTrail — never a stored counter.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Whether this budget applies to the whole organisation or to one agent.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the budgeted agent. Required when scope=agent; empty for scope=organisation.

period.title: Period
period.description: The recurring window current-period usage is windowed to.

tokenLimit.title: Token limit
tokenLimit.description: Hard token cap per period. At least one of tokenLimit/eurLimit is required (service-level validation).

eurLimit.title: EUR limit
eurLimit.description: Hard EUR cap per period. Only usable when the instance-wide EUR-per-1k-tokens rate is configured.

softThresholdPercent.title: Soft threshold (%)
softThresholdPercent.description: When current-period usage crosses this fraction of the limit, one warning notification fires per period.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: A disabled budget is not read by the dispatch gate (kept, not deleted, for audit continuity).

warnedPeriodKey.title: Warned period key
warnedPeriodKey.description: Derived: the period key the soft-threshold warning was last sent for; empty until the first warning in a period.

lastHardBlockAt.title: Last hard block at
lastHardBlockAt.description: Derived: when a run was last blocked by this budget's hard cap, for admin visibility.

Memory.title: Agent memory
Memory.description: An agent's long-term memory (the MEMORY.md port): durable facts stored as JSON entries with a character budget. Exceeding the budget flags needsConsolidation — a nudge to summarise, never a silent truncation.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent this memory belongs to.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Memory entries as a JSON array.

charBudget.title: Character budget
charBudget.description: Character budget for entries; exceeding it flags needsConsolidation (approximate, not a hard cap).

needsConsolidation.title: Needs consolidation
needsConsolidation.description: True when the entries exceed charBudget — a nudge to consolidate; older entries are never dropped silently.

UserProfile.title: User profile
UserProfile.description: Facts an agent keeps about a subject user (the USER.md port): durable entries with a character budget and consolidation nudge, scoped to the owning organisation.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent maintaining this profile.

subjectUid.title: Subject user
subjectUid.description: The user id the profile describes.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Profile entries as a JSON array.

text.title: Text
text.description: The remembered fact about the subject user.

charBudget.title: Character budget
charBudget.description: Character budget for entries; exceeding it flags needsConsolidation.

needsConsolidation.title: Needs consolidation
needsConsolidation.description: True when the entries exceed charBudget.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: A conversation session between a user and an agent (the FTS5 session port). Turns are stored as SessionTurn children so each is individually searchable and org-scoped.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent in this session.

lastActivityAt.title: Last activity at
lastActivityAt.description: When the most recent turn was recorded.

SessionTurn.title: Session turn
SessionTurn.description: A single turn within a Session — the searchable unit for cross-session recall via OpenRegister search/vectorization (no bespoke SQLite/FTS5 index).

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent (denormalised copy of the parent Session's agentId, kept for recall-filter performance — not the canonical source; Session.agentId is authoritative).

content.title: Content
content.description: The turn content — the field searched for recall.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: A self-improving agent skill in the agentskills.io format (ported from Hermes). Stores the raw frontmatter block (byte-preserved for lossless round-trip), the body, auxiliary files, a lifecycle state, and which agents it is installed on. Slug namespaced (agentskill) to avoid a cross-app slug collision.

frontmatter.title: Frontmatter
frontmatter.description: The raw agentskills.io YAML frontmatter block, preserved byte-for-byte for lossless serialisation.

state.title: State
state.description: Skill lifecycle state. A skill installed from another org or an external hub starts 'quarantined' and must pass review before 'active' (skills-marketplace).

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the skill came from: locally authored, another organisation, or an external hub.

quarantineReason.title: Quarantine reason
quarantineReason.description: Why the skill is quarantined (set when installed from an external source).

lastActivityAt.title: Last activity at
lastActivityAt.description: When the skill was last created/imported/approved — the Curator's staleness clock.

staleSince.title: Stale since
staleSince.description: When the Curator marked the skill stale.

archivedAt.title: Archived at
archivedAt.description: When the Curator archived the skill (never hard-deleted).

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: The user id who imported/created the skill.

installedOn.title: Installed on
installedOn.description: Agent UUIDs this skill is installed on.

scanReport.title: Scan report
scanReport.description: Heuristic content-scan verdict from OpenRegister ContentScanService, recorded at install and re-checked at approval (skills-marketplace). A 'dangerous' verdict blocks one-click approval.

category.title: Category
category.description: The kind of dangerous pattern matched (e.g. remote-code, exfiltration).

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: The severity of this individual finding.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: The matched excerpt from the scanned content.

SkillSource.title: Skill source
SkillSource.description: The origin of a skill (a package, an external agentskills.io hub, or local) — the seam for the V2 skills-marketplace cross-org sharing.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: An autonomous AI agent: its LLM provider/model configuration, RAG and quota settings, visibility, and tool whitelist. Tenant scope (owner/organisation) is inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here. Also carries the agent-lifecycle-governance offboarding flag and periodic review attestation.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of what the agent does.

type.title: Type
type.description: Free-form agent type label (e.g. chat, automation, analysis, assistant); no fixed enum observed at HEAD.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: LLM provider the agent runs on (e.g. openai, ollama, fireworks, azure).

model.title: Model
model.description: Model identifier used by the provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, llama3).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: System prompt: instructions and context given to the LLM.

maxTokens.title: Max tokens
maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the agent may generate per response.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Additional JSON configuration for advanced provider/model settings.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the agent is active and available to run.

enableRag.title: Enable RAG
enableRag.description: Whether Retrieval-Augmented Generation is used to ground responses in context.

ragSearchMode.title: RAG search mode
ragSearchMode.description: Search mode used for RAG context retrieval (e.g. hybrid, semantic, keyword).

ragNumSources.title: RAG number of sources
ragNumSources.description: Number of context sources retrieved for RAG.

ragIncludeFiles.title: RAG include files
ragIncludeFiles.description: Whether Nextcloud files are included as RAG context sources.

ragIncludeObjects.title: RAG include objects
ragIncludeObjects.description: Whether OpenRegister objects are included as RAG context sources.

requestQuota.title: Request quota
requestQuota.description: Maximum number of requests the agent may serve per day (0 = unlimited).

tokenQuota.title: Token quota
tokenQuota.description: Maximum number of tokens the agent may consume per day (0 = unlimited).

views.title: Views
views.description: UUIDs of views that filter which data the agent can access.

searchFiles.title: Search files
searchFiles.description: Whether the agent searches Nextcloud files.

searchObjects.title: Search objects
searchObjects.description: Whether the agent searches OpenRegister objects.

isPrivate.title: Private
isPrivate.description: Whether the agent is private (not shared with the whole organisation).

invitedUsers.title: Invited users
invitedUsers.description: User ids invited to access a private agent.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Nextcloud group ids with access to this agent.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: The fleet MCP tool grant list, enforced at turn assembly. Entries: an exact id ({appId}.{toolName} or {app}.{schema}.{verb}) grants that tool verbatim; {app}.{schema}.* grants that schema's read verbs only (search/get); {app}.{schema}.*:write additionally grants its write verbs (create/update/delete); an empty array means every discovered tool is allowed. A schema wildcard NEVER grants write/destructive tools by default (default-deny) — name them explicitly, or add the :write modifier, to grant them.

actingUser.title: Acting user
actingUser.description: NC user id the agent impersonates for this run's ObjectService writes/Files/deliveries. Must be an existing, active user; when unset, runs impersonate the schedule owner (default, unchanged behavior).

user.title: Run-as user
user.description: User id whose permissions and organisation context the agent runs under when there is no active session (e.g. cron/background runs). Legacy: superseded by actingUser.

skillInstalls.title: Skill installs
skillInstalls.description: Skill uuids explicitly installed on this agent; the allowlist a future run loop uses to decide which skills are exposed to it. Kept in sync by SkillService::installOnAgent().

contextRefs.title: Context refs
contextRefs.description: Context object uuids attached to this agent; each is assembled into a budgeted text preamble prepended to the system prompt at run start.

reassignmentFlag.title: Flagged for reassignment
reassignmentFlag.description: Derived: true when this agent's owning Nextcloud user was deleted or disabled and its schedules were auto-paused (agent-lifecycle-governance offboarding); cleared once an org admin reassigns actingUser to a new active user.

reviewedAt.title: Reviewed at
reviewedAt.description: Derived: when an org admin last attested this agent as reviewed in the periodic access review (agent-lifecycle-governance); re-attesting updates this timestamp rather than duplicating a record.

reviewedBy.title: Reviewed by
reviewedBy.description: Derived: the user id of the org admin who last recorded the reviewed attestation (agent-lifecycle-governance).

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A chat thread bound to one Agent. Tenant scope and soft-delete/timestamps are inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable conversation title (typically auto-generated by the LLM).

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The user id who owns this conversation.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the Agent object this conversation runs against.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Additional JSON metadata such as a summary, token count, or message count.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: One turn within a Conversation, optionally carrying RAG sources and an AI Chat Companion context snapshot.

conversationId.title: Conversation
conversationId.description: UUID of the Conversation object this message belongs to.

role.title: Role
role.description: Who produced this message: system, user, assistant, or tool.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: RAG sources used to generate the response (assistant messages only).

id.title: Source ID
id.description: UUID of the source file or object.

type.title: Source type
type.description: Whether the source is a file or an object.

similarity.title: Similarity
similarity.description: Similarity score of the source to the query.

context.title: Context
context.description: AI Chat Companion context snapshot captured when the message was sent (appId, pageKind, objectUuid, registerSlug, schemaSlug, route, capturedAt), preserved verbatim as free-form JSON.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: A rating on one Message, referencing its Conversation and Agent by uuid. Tenant scope (organisation) is inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here.

messageId.title: Message
messageId.description: UUID of the Message this feedback rates.

conversationId.title: Conversation
conversationId.description: UUID of the Conversation the rated message belongs to.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the Agent that produced the rated message.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The user id who submitted this feedback.

type.title: Type
type.description: Whether the feedback is positive or negative.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Optional free-text comment explaining the feedback.

Context.title: Context
Context.description: A named, budgeted bundle of files, object-queries, and view refs, resolved at run start into a text preamble prepended to the system prompt. Tenant scope is inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of this context bundle.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of what this context bundle provides.

files.title: Files
files.description: Nextcloud files to include, read from the acting user's folder.

path.title: Path
path.description: File path relative to the acting user's Nextcloud folder.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional note on why this file is included.

objectQueries.title: Object queries
objectQueries.description: OpenRegister queries to include, each run via ObjectService at assembly time.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Equality filters applied to the query.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum objects to return for this query.

viewRefs.title: View refs
viewRefs.description: UUIDs of views that would further filter which data is included (resolution deferred — mirrors the same unresolved gap on Agent.views).

charBudget.title: Character budget
charBudget.description: Character budget for the assembled preamble; exceeding it flags needsConsolidation (approximate, not a hard cap).

needsConsolidation.title: Needs consolidation
needsConsolidation.description: Derived: true when the last assembly exceeded charBudget — a nudge to narrow the bundle; content is never silently truncated.

Incident.title: Incident
Incident.description: A human-authored incident record (agent-lifecycle-governance): what happened, its impact, and the actions taken, optionally linked to an Agent and/or one or more runs (AuditTrail entry uuids). Persisted as a durable, tenant-scoped OpenRegister object so it inherits owner/organisation scoping and an AuditTrail entry automatically (ADR-004), and is included in the EU AI Act Art. 12 audit export alongside run/approval entries.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: The impact of the incident (e.g. severity, who/what was affected).

actionsTaken.title: Actions taken
actionsTaken.description: The remedial actions taken in response to the incident.

linkedAgentId.title: Linked agent
linkedAgentId.description: UUID of the Agent this incident concerns, if any.

linkedRunIds.title: Linked runs
linkedRunIds.description: AuditTrail entry uuids of the run(s) this incident concerns, if any (a "run" has no own OpenRegister object — it is identified by its AuditTrail entry uuid, exactly as RunHistoryService already surfaces run ids).

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: Derived: when the incident record was opened — written by the create endpoint.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: Derived: the user id of the org admin who opened the incident — written by the create endpoint.

CourseRecommendation.title: Course recommendation
CourseRecommendation.description: A per-learner, per-source-app snapshot of a ranked next-best-course recommendation list (course-recommendations), the deterministic signals consulted to produce it, and how its explanation text was produced. Advisory only — no field represents acceptance, enrolment, or any automated action (EU AI Act Annex III §3).

learnerId.title: Learner ID
learnerId.description: The Nextcloud user id of the learner this recommendation set was generated for (self-scoped identity key).

sourceApp.title: Source app
sourceApp.description: The leaf app the signals were read from; hard-coded to scholiq at this revision, kept generic for a future second adapter.

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: Mirrors the source app's tenant_id — multi-tenant isolation, not translated.

status.title: Status
status.description: Freshness/availability of this recommendation set. A plain field managed by the service, not a governed lifecycle transition.

generatedAt.title: Generated at
generatedAt.description: When this recommendation set was last computed.

staleAt.title: Stale at
staleAt.description: When this recommendation set becomes stale and due for lazy regeneration on next read (generatedAt + a fixed TTL).

signalsUsed.title: Signals used
signalsUsed.description: Snapshot of signal availability/counts consulted to produce this recommendation set — audit/debug substrate, not shown to the learner.

enrolmentCount.title: Enrolment count
enrolmentCount.description: Number of the learner's Enrolment records read.

completedCourseCount.title: Completed course count
completedCourseCount.description: Number of the learner's completed Enrolment records.

xapiStatementCount.title: xAPI statement count
xapiStatementCount.description: Number of the learner's XapiStatement records read.

goalCount.title: Goal count
goalCount.description: Number of LearningPlan goals read across the learner's plans.

competencyDataAvailable.title: Competency data available
competencyDataAvailable.description: Whether the optional wave-2 competency-attainment read succeeded and returned data.

candidateCount.title: Candidate count
candidateCount.description: How many eligible (published, not-yet-enrolled) courses were scored.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.description: The ranked recommendation list — deterministic rank/score/matchedSignals, optionally LLM-phrased explanation.

courseId.title: Course ID
courseId.description: UUID of the recommended Course in the source app's own register (foreign key into Scholiq's Course register — no cross-register $ref).

courseCode.title: Course code
courseCode.description: The recommended course's code, snapshotted at generation time.

courseName.title: Course name
courseName.description: The recommended course's name, snapshotted at generation time.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: 1-based rank of this course within the recommendation list.

score.title: Score
score.description: The deterministic weighted-signal score that produced this rank.

matchedSignals.title: Matched signals
matchedSignals.description: Which named signals contributed to this course's score — the explainability substrate.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: A plain-language explanation grounded strictly in this course's own matchedSignals — template-built or LLM-phrased, never absent.

explanationMode.title: Explanation mode
explanationMode.description: Which path produced the explanation text for this recommendation set.

modelUsed.title: Model used
modelUsed.description: Provider/model identifier when explanationMode is llm-assisted; null otherwise.

viewedAt.title: Viewed at
viewedAt.description: When the learner last opened this recommendation list (reserved for a future scholiq-side surface; not written by this change).
